## Episode Thesis

This was a short news-driven morning briefing. Market attention moved away from the US-Iran conflict and towards AI-driven demand, which lifted tech and semiconductor stocks in Asia and the US while oil held flat around $76. In Sweden the focus was the quarterly reports season: Bulten sold its European contract manufacturing business, Sivers' CEO bought shares after a 62% fall from the record, Fagerhult presented a 220 MSEK earnings improvement plan, and Besqab and Avarda reported stronger operating profit. The host gave no buy or sell views; everything was reported as news.
